results.title: Temples of time [Short Version]
results.creator_credit: William Canning and National Film Board of Canada
results.brief_description: A mountain is a living thing; it has an ecological balance, a process of evolution manifested in slow, subtle ways; but it is also subject to the ravages of man’s technology. Filmed in the Canadian Rockies and in Garibaldi Park, this picture brings to the screen magnificent footage of mountain solitudes and the wildlife found there, of natural splendor in all its changing moods. The film carries the implicit warning that all this may pass away if people do not seek to preserve it. Film without words.

results.title: Tess of the D'urbervilles
results.creator_credit: Ian Sharp, Sarah Wilson, Granada International Productions, A&E Television Networks and LWT
results.brief_description: Justine Waddell plays the title role of tragic heroine Tess, sent away to work with distant relatives because of the abject poverty she and her family find themselves in. Working on the estate, Tess is relentlessly pursued and finally seduced by Alec D’Urberville. Tess flees from the estate only to discover she is pregnant; she loses the child and moves away from home once more. This time she starts work as a milkmaid, and love finds her again when she marries Angel Clare. When Angel discovers what happened between his wife and D’Urberville he abandons Tess who is left alone, once more forced to survive in harsh circumstances. Cast includes Justine Waddell, Jason Flemyng and Oliver Milburn.

results.title: Tess
results.brief_description: A faithful rendition of Thomas Hardy’s story of Victorian sexual and social hypocrisy. The pure village maiden Tess, supposed poor relation of the wealthy D’Urbervilles is seduced by one man and treated unfairly by another. Nastassia Kinski is perfect in the role of the doomed Tess.

results.title: Temple of twenty pagodas
results.creator_credit: Brian Hannant, John Morris and Australian National Film Board
results.brief_description:
Episode of Series “Our Asian Neighbours: Thailand”.
In Northern Island is a monastery said to be two thousand years old. It is called “Wa Chedi Sao”, which in Northern Thai means the Temple of Twenty Pagodas. This film is about the daily life of the monastery and the village which it serves.

results.title: Terra Nullius
results.creator_credit: Alison Wotherspoon, Anne Pratten and AFTRS
results.brief_description: Loosely based on the filmmaker’s personal experience, “Terra Nullius” is an impressionistic account of an eight year old Koori girl, Alice, growing up in a white adoptive family which denies her Aboriginality. The film examines how unacknowledged shame and fear passes from one generation to the next, from one culture to another. The last scene depicts a silent meeting between the young Alice and the adult Alice. In order to reclaim her life, Alice decides she must confront the pain and confusion of her childhood.
